<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Android status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <line x1="327" y1="19" x2="327" y2="14"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="19" x2="331" y2="12"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="19" x2="335" y2="10"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5">
    <path d="M345 17 Q350 11 355 17"/>
    <path d="M347 19 Q350 15 353 19"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="350" cy="21" r="1.4" fill="#323232"/>

  <rect x="365" y="13" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="382" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  
  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="69" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="22" y="64" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Find your flight</text>
    <text x="22" y="86" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Where would you like to go?</text>
    <g stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <line x1="353" y1="54" x2="353" y2="70"/>
      <line x1="345" y1="62" x2="361" y2="62"/>
      <circle cx="353" cy="62" r="11"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Trip type tabs -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="112" width="350" height="45" rx="10" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
    <rect x="24" y="116" width="111" height="37" rx="8" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="79" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Round trip</text>
    <text x="195" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">One way</text>
    <text x="316" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">Multi-city</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Route card shadow -->
  <rect x="20" y="174" width="350" height="171" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
  <rect x="20" y="170" width="350" height="171" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="195" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">ROUTE</text>
  
  <!-- From -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="45" cy="222" r="9" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="222" r="3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="64" y="218" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">FROM</text>
    <text x="64" y="237" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Jakarta</text>
    <text x="151" y="237" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">CGK</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="38" y1="254" x2="352" y2="254" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- To -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="45,270 51,281 39,281" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="64" y="273" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">TO</text>
    <text x="64" y="292" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Bali</text>
    <text x="105" y="292" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">DPS</text>
  </g>
  <!-- swap -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="326" cy="254" r="21" fill="#FFF1F3" stroke="#FFD3D1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="316,250 332,250 328,246" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="336,258 320,258 324,262" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <text x="370" y="374" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Calendar</text>
  
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="389" width="168" height="72" rx="12" fill="#FFF1F3" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <line x1="42" y1="414" x2="42" y2="409" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="414" x2="46" y2="416" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="34" y="443" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Fri, 18 Jul</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="389" width="168" height="72" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <line x1="224" y1="414" x2="224" y2="409" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="414" x2="228" y2="416" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="216" y="443" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Mon, 21 Jul</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- passenger and class -->
  <text x="20" y="493" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Passengers & class</text>

    <line x1="265" y1="519" x2="265" y2="553" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="285" y="531" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">CLASS</text>
    <text x="285" y="550" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Economy</text>
    <polyline points="348,532 353,537 358,532" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- promo row -->

    <circle cx="43" cy="605" r="11" fill="#FFD3D1"/>

    <line x1="43" y1="600" x2="43" y2="610" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="63" y="618" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Save more on your next trip</text>
    <text x="350" y="608" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Add</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- search button -->

    <rect x="20" y="647" width="350" height="54" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>

    <text x="45" y="727" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Flexible dates can help you save</text>
    <text x="45" y="744" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Prices shown include taxes and fees.</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="49" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>

    <text x="127" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Search</text>

    <line x1="209" y1="787" x2="209" y2="793" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="205" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">My trips</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="293" cy="795" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="293" cy="807" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="293" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Account</text>
  </g>
  <!-- More -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="354" cy="797" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="797" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <circle cx="372" cy="797" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <text x="363" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">More</text>
  </g>
